استجوبت (form X)
# اِسْتَجْوَبْتُ (istajwabtu) /is.tad͡ʒ.wab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# اِسْتَجْوَبْتَ (istajwabta) /is.tad͡ʒ.wab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# اِسْتَجْوَبْتِ (istajwabti) /is.tad͡ʒ.wab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# اِسْتَجْوَبَتْ (istajwabat)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
